articles.summary: January 2026 – In the latest edition of our Private Credit Insights series, Crescent President Chris Wright and Managing Director Chris Wang describe the current state of the U.S. private credit market, and their view of its resilience and relevance going deeper into 2026.
articles.title: Crescent Private Credit Insights: January 2026

articles.summary: Crescent Capital Group LP, one of the leading alternative credit investment firms, and Pantheon, one of the leading global private markets investors, today announced the closing of Crescent Credit Solutions VII CV (“CCS VII CV”), a $3.2 billion private credit continuation vehicle. CCS VII CV was established to acquire a diversified portfolio of performing sponsor-backed loans and securities and other equity interests from Crescent Mezzanine Partners VII, a 2016-vintage fund.
articles.title: Crescent Closes $3.2 Billion Private Credit Continuation Vehicle
